speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To better understand your condition, can you describe the nature of your flank pain and whether you have noticed any changes in your urine, such as color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Since your symptoms persisted after your sinusitis improved, I need to rule out other causes. Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any blood in your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: The development of a rash with amoxicillin followed by persistent fever and flank pain is highly suggestive of acute interstitial nephritis. Do you have any swelling in your legs or face, and have you noticed a decrease in your urine output?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying those symptoms. To confirm the diagnosis of acute interstitial nephritis, I need to assess your kidney function. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Serum_Creatinine, CBC
